Package mesos.am30.gameModel.board

package mesos.am30.gameModel.board
Package for the Game logic implementation.
This Package contains the implementation of the Game itself; it handles the updates of the Game state due to all possibles Player's actions, as well as the turn update and communication.
The communication logic has been implemented following the ModelViewController Pattern.
